title: M$^\star$: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness
abstract: arXiv:2604.11811v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model agents rely on a memory harness to write, organize, retrieve, and use past experience. A harness that works for one task often fails on another, because conversations, embodied planning, and expert reasoning require different storage and retrieval behavior. To address this limitation, we introduce Mstar, a method that automatically discovers task-optimized memory programs through reflective code evolution. Specifically, Mstar operationalizes a memory harness as an executable Python memory program that defines the Schema, Logic, and Instruction, and optimizes these components jointly. We evaluate Mstar on four tasks covering conversation, embodied planning, and specialized reasoning. Our results demonstrate that Mstar improves performance over existing baselines across all evaluated tasks. Furthermore, the evolved memory programs exhibit structurally distinct processing mechanisms for each evaluated domain.

translated_title: M$^\star$：每个任务都值得拥有专属的记忆框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体依赖记忆框架来写入、组织、检索和使用过往经验。然而，适用于某一任务的记忆框架在另一任务上往往表现不佳，因为对话、具身规划和专家推理需要不同的存储与检索行为。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Mstar，一种通过反思性代码演化自动发现任务优化记忆程序的方法。具体而言，Mstar将记忆框架实现为一个可执行的Python记忆程序，该程序定义了模式、逻辑和指令，并对这些组件进行联合优化。我们在涵盖对话、具身规划和专业推理的四个任务上评估了Mstar。结果表明，Mstar在所有评估任务上的性能均优于现有基线方法。此外，演化得到的记忆程序在各个评估领域展现出结构上截然不同的处理机制。
tldr: 提出Mstar方法，通过反思性代码演化自动为每个任务生成并联合优化包含模式、逻辑和指令的可执行Python记忆程序，在对话、具身规划和专业推理等任务上均超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: M$^\star$ automatically discovers task-optimized memory harnesses through reflective code evolution, jointly optimizing executable Python memory programs (Schema, Logic, Instruction) that outperform existing baselines across conversation, embodied planning, and specialized reasoning tasks.
